deletion.ownerQuestion: Are you sure you are the owner of this node?
deletion.ownerOnly: Only the owner can manage this node and request its removal from the map.
deletion.captchaPrompt: A quick check to confirm you're not a bot.
deletion.ready: Open the prepared email, check that its contents are correct, then send it. Each request is reviewed individually. It is also helpful to include the reason for removal.

mail.ownershipConfirmation: I CONFIRM THAT I OWN ALL NODES LISTED ABOVE AND REQUEST THEIR REMOVAL FROM THE MESHCORE MAP DATABASE. I HAVE CHECKED THE PUBLIC KEYS OR MESHCORE LINKS AND CONFIRM THAT THIS REQUEST COVERS ONLY THE NODES I INTEND TO REMOVE.
mail.instructions: Check that the public key above belongs to the node you want to remove. Only request removal of nodes you own. To remove several of your nodes, add their public keys or MeshCore contact links (meshcore://contact/add?...), one per line, and send a single request. Full public keys are sufficient; names and screenshots are not needed. You may add a brief reason for removal in English. Keep the subject, removal request and ownership confirmation in English so the recipient can review your request. Opening the email does not submit the request or remove the node from the map.

baseMapInfo.CartoDB Dark: Dark street map from CARTO. Free with no stated request limit, but not meant for very heavy traffic.
baseMapInfo.CartoDB Positron: Light, minimalist street map from CARTO. Free with no stated request limit, but not meant for very heavy traffic.
baseMapInfo.OpenStreetMap: Standard OpenStreetMap map from the official tile server. Meant for regular browsing, not bulk downloads, heavy caching or offline use.
baseMapInfo.Esri Hybrid: Esri satellite imagery with boundaries and place labels overlaid.
baseMapInfo.OpenTopoMap: Topographic map served by a community server with limited bandwidth. Avoid generating heavy traffic.
baseMapInfo.MapTiler Outdoor: MapTiler outdoor map with roads, trails and topographic information.
baseMapInfo.MapTiler Hybrid: MapTiler satellite imagery with boundaries and local place labels overlaid.
baseMapInfo.CyclOSM: Cycling map based on OpenStreetMap data. Uses the openstreetmap.fr community server, so keep traffic moderate.
baseMapInfo.Humanitarian OSM: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap style developed by HOT. Uses the openstreetmap.fr community server, so keep traffic moderate.
baseMapInfo.OpenFreeMap: Vector street map rendered by MapLibre. Free with no stated request limit, but requires WebGL support and may be heavier on the device.
